Participants include software developers, distributors, and service providers operating globally across various industries such as automotive, aerospace, and manufacturing.

#### About the COMSOL Product Suite

The COMSOL Multiphysics^{®} software brings a user interface and experience that is always the same,
regardless of engineering application and physics phenomena.

Add-on modules provide specialized functionality for electromagnetics, structural mechanics,
acoustics, fluid flow, heat transfer, and chemical engineering. Choose from a list of LiveLink™
products to interface directly with CAD and other third-party software. Deploy simulation
applications with COMSOL Compiler™ and COMSOL Server™.

[Explore Product Suite ][38]
COMSOL Multiphysics^{®}

Create physics-based models and simulation applications with this software platform. The Model
Builder enables you to combine multiple physics in any order for simulations of real-world
phenomena. The Application Builder gives you the tools to build your own simulation apps. The Model
Manager is a modeling and simulation management tool.

[View COMSOL Multiphysics^{®} ][39]

SIMULATION APP DEPLOYMENT
COMSOL Compiler™

Compile apps into standalone executable files that can be run by anyone, anywhere.

[View COMSOL Compiler™ ][40]
SIMULATION APP DEPLOYMENT
COMSOL Server™

Manage and distribute your organization's apps and run them via web browser or thin client.

[View COMSOL Server™ ][41]

Get to Know COMSOL

At COMSOL, we develop mathematical modeling software that drives new breakthroughs in physics and
engineering — and we love what we do.

Our mission is to provide easy-to-use software solutions to engineering problems and to help our
users get the most out of our products. We envision sustaining and reinforcing our position as a
leading provider and developer of mathematical modeling software. We also aim to make our technology
the primary tool for engineers, researchers, and lecturers within the fields of education and
high-tech product development.

**Quick Facts**
* Founded in 1986
* 16 offices and a distributor network throughout the world
* 500+ employees globally

[Keep Reading  ][46]

##### Work at COMSOL

Help us shape the future of scientific computing. Browse job openings across departments and
offices.

Bij In Summa is juist dit wat wij zichtbaar willen maken voor onze klanten in de maakindustrie,
transportsector en zorg. Als Microsoft Solution partner maken wij data toegankelijk en beschikbaar

## Realisatie door betrokken en gedreven engineers

Daarnaast is In Summa exclusieve business partner van Hexagon’s Computer-Aided Engineering platform
voor de Benelux regio. Met deze state-of-the-art simulatiesoftware kunnen engineers en researchers
uit verschillende industriële sectoren ontwerpen virtueel en proactief testen op veiligheid,
kosten en duurzaamheid. Zo optimaliseren we samen resources voor diverse industriële sectoren. 

Omdat onze toegewijde en gedreven engineers de [Hexagon][24] tools van binnen en van buiten kennen,
kunnen wij onze klanten bovendien optimaal ondersteunen met advies en training.

en de synergie tussen onze young potentials en vakrotten resulteren in een hecht teamgevoel.

# Optimize the world using data

De snel veranderende wereld van vandaag stelt organisaties voortdurend voor nieuwe uitdagingen.
Energietransitie, stijgende grondstofprijzen en een tekort aan gekwalificeerde mensen dwingen je
steeds kritischer om te gaan met resources. Hier komt In Summa om de hoek kijken.

[ Vraag advies aan ][18]
[ Over in summa ][19]

[Computer-Aided Engineering][20]

[Data Solutions ][21]

[Over in Summa][22]

## Data toegankelijk in praktische business intelligence dashboards

Bij In Summa is juist dit wat wij zichtbaar willen maken voor onze klanten in de maakindustrie,
transportsector en zorg. Als Microsoft Solution partner maken wij data toegankelijk en beschikbaar
in praktische business intelligence dashboards. Dankzij onze intensieve kennis van de branches en de
processen kunnen onze data engineers bedrijfsprocessen effectief optimaliseren door databronnen slim
met software te verbinden.

[ Ontdek meer over Business Intelligence ][23]

## Realisatie door betrokken en gedreven engineers

Daarnaast is In Summa exclusieve business partner van Hexagon’s Computer-Aided Engineering platform
voor de Benelux regio. Met deze state-of-the-art simulatiesoftware kunnen engineers en researchers
uit verschillende industriële sectoren ontwerpen virtueel en proactief testen op veiligheid,
kosten en duurzaamheid. Zo optimaliseren we samen resources voor diverse industriële sectoren. 

Omdat onze toegewijde en gedreven engineers de [Hexagon][24] tools van binnen en van buiten kennen,
kunnen wij onze klanten bovendien optimaal ondersteunen met advies en training.

[ Ontdek meer over Simulatie Software ][25]

## En dat sinds 1998, met een enorme passie voor data en techniek

Dat doen wij al sinds 1998 met een enorme passie voor data en techniek en een echte
resultaatgerichte, no-nonsense mentaliteit. In een open, transparante werkomgeving geven wij onze
specialisten graag de ruimte om het beste uit zichzelf te halen. De liefde voor het vak, de vrijheid
en de synergie tussen onze young potentials en vakrotten resulteren in een hecht teamgevoel.

## Werken in een data gedreven organisatie?

Bij In Summa werken wij voor klanten in de [maakindustrie][26], [transportsector][27] en [zorg][28].
En als [Microsoft Solution partner][29] maken wij data toegankelijk en beschikbaar in praktische
business intelligence dashboards. Dit doen wij in een hecht team dat op elkaar bouwt. Elke dag weer
werken we aan de mooiste resultaten. Ben jij enthousiast geworden en wil je bij ons werken?
Solliciteer dan vandaag nog!

# Siemens acquires Altair

Altair has been acquired by Siemens, creating the world's most complete AI-powered portfolio of
industrial software for simulation, high-performance computing, data science and artificial

#### About the COMSOL Product Suite

The COMSOL Multiphysics^{®} software brings a user interface and experience that is always the same,
regardless of engineering application and physics phenomena.

Add-on modules provide specialized functionality for electromagnetics, structural mechanics,
acoustics, fluid flow, heat transfer, and chemical engineering. Choose from a list of LiveLink™
products to interface directly with CAD and other third-party software. Deploy simulation
applications with COMSOL Compiler™ and COMSOL Server™.

[Explore Product Suite ][38]
COMSOL Multiphysics^{®}

Create physics-based models and simulation applications with this software platform. The Model
Builder enables you to combine multiple physics in any order for simulations of real-world
phenomena. The Application Builder gives you the tools to build your own simulation apps. The Model
Manager is a modeling and simulation management tool.

[View COMSOL Multiphysics^{®} ][39]

SIMULATION APP DEPLOYMENT
COMSOL Compiler™

Compile apps into standalone executable files that can be run by anyone, anywhere.

[View COMSOL Compiler™ ][40]

COMSOL Server™

Manage and distribute your organization's apps and run them via web browser or thin client.

[View COMSOL Server™ ][41]

Get to Know COMSOL

At COMSOL, we develop mathematical modeling software that drives new breakthroughs in physics and
engineering — and we love what we do.

Our mission is to provide easy-to-use software solutions to engineering problems and to help our
users get the most out of our products. We envision sustaining and reinforcing our position as a
leading provider and developer of mathematical modeling software. We also aim to make our technology
the primary tool for engineers, researchers, and lecturers within the fields of education and
high-tech product development.

**Quick Facts**
* Founded in 1986
* 16 offices and a distributor network throughout the world
* 500+ employees globally

vehicles on the road ahead.

# Welcome To EL FORGE

EL FORGE is one of the leading forging producers in South India with over of 6 decades of experience
in metal forming. EL FORGE serves major vehicle and automotive component manufacturers and process
industries, both domestic and overseas. The range of materials handled include Micro alloy steels,
Carbon, Alloy and Stainless Steel, and supplies are made both as forged and machined.

[

][57]

developing World Class manufacturing technology and practices through a continually developing

# Golden is now part of *ComplyAdvantage.*

We set out to build a self-constructing knowledge graph of the world's information. In 2024, that
technology found its home inside ComplyAdvantage — powering financial crime intelligence for over
1,000 enterprises.

The acquisition

## Acquired by ComplyAdvantage in 2024.

On 24 April 2024, ComplyAdvantage — the AI-driven financial crime intelligence firm protecting over
1,000 enterprises across 75 countries — acquired Golden.

01

### Into the ingestion layer

Golden's data extraction and entity-disambiguation methods now feed ComplyAdvantage's ingestion
pipeline, sharpening real-time risk insights for regulated institutions.

02

### Two teams, united

Golden's AI and large-language-model specialists joined ComplyAdvantage's data science team to build
on interconnected data at scale.

03

### Founder as advisor

Founder and CEO Jude Gomila joined ComplyAdvantage as a board observer and special advisor. a16z
became a top shareholder of the combined company.

"Financial crime insights built on *interconnected data* have been our north star."
[Visit ComplyAdvantage →][5]
The story

## A self-constructing knowledge base.

Golden set out to map human knowledge with machine intelligence — automating one of the world's
largest knowledge graphs from millions of disparate sources.

Founded · 2017 Golden

Jude Gomila starts Golden in San Francisco to combine artificial and human intelligence into one
continuously reconciled record.

Seed · 2019 $5M

a16z, Founders Fund, Gigafund and SV Angel back the first self-constructing knowledge database.

Series A · 2021 $14.5M

Led by a16z; Marc Andreessen joins the board. Golden closes a $1M US Air Force contract.

Series B · 2022 $40M

a16z leads again to scale the graph, bringing Golden's total funding to roughly $59.5M.

Acquired · 2024 ComplyAdvantage

Golden joins ComplyAdvantage to power AI-enriched financial crime intelligence worldwide.

The team

## Founder, engineers, and the investors behind them.

Golden was founded by Jude Gomila — a Cambridge engineer who previously co-founded the mobile
platform Heyzap (acquired 2016) — and built by a small team of AI, NLP and knowledge-graph
specialists.

Founder & CEO Jude Gomila

Set the mission of mapping the world's knowledge; now board observer and special advisor at
ComplyAdvantage.

Lead investor a16z

Andreessen Horowitz backed every round; Marc Andreessen served on Golden's board.

Backers Founders Fund

With Gigafund, SV Angel, DCVC and angels — roughly $59.5M raised across seed, Series A and Series B.

The team AI & NLP

Engineers specialising in data extraction, entity disambiguation and large language models — now
part of ComplyAdvantage's data science team.

[GOLDEN.com][6]

A self-constructing knowledge graph founded in San Francisco in 2017. Acquired by ComplyAdvantage in
2024.

## Acquired by ComplyAdvantage in 2024.

On 24 April 2024, ComplyAdvantage — the AI-driven financial crime intelligence firm protecting over
1,000 enterprises across 75 countries — acquired Golden.

01

### Into the ingestion layer

Golden's data extraction and entity-disambiguation methods now feed ComplyAdvantage's ingestion
pipeline, sharpening real-time risk insights for regulated institutions.

02

### Two teams, united

Golden's AI and large-language-model specialists joined ComplyAdvantage's data science team to build
on interconnected data at scale.

03

### Founder as advisor

Founder and CEO Jude Gomila joined ComplyAdvantage as a board observer and special advisor. a16z
became a top shareholder of the combined company.

# Optimize the world using data

De snel veranderende wereld van vandaag stelt organisaties voortdurend voor nieuwe uitdagingen.
Energietransitie, stijgende grondstofprijzen en een tekort aan gekwalificeerde mensen dwingen je
steeds kritischer om te gaan met resources. Hier komt In Summa om de hoek kijken.

## Data toegankelijk in praktische business intelligence dashboards

Bij In Summa is juist dit wat wij zichtbaar willen maken voor onze klanten in de maakindustrie,
transportsector en zorg. Als Microsoft Solution partner maken wij data toegankelijk en beschikbaar
in praktische business intelligence dashboards. Dankzij onze intensieve kennis van de branches en de
processen kunnen onze data engineers bedrijfsprocessen effectief optimaliseren door databronnen slim
met software te verbinden.

[ Ontdek meer over Business Intelligence ][23]

## Realisatie door betrokken en gedreven engineers

Daarnaast is In Summa exclusieve business partner van Hexagon’s Computer-Aided Engineering platform
voor de Benelux regio. Met deze state-of-the-art simulatiesoftware kunnen engineers en researchers
uit verschillende industriële sectoren ontwerpen virtueel en proactief testen op veiligheid,
kosten en duurzaamheid. Zo optimaliseren we samen resources voor diverse industriële sectoren. 

Omdat onze toegewijde en gedreven engineers de [Hexagon][24] tools van binnen en van buiten kennen,
kunnen wij onze klanten bovendien optimaal ondersteunen met advies en training.

[ Ontdek meer over Simulatie Software ][25]

## En dat sinds 1998, met een enorme passie voor data en techniek

Dat doen wij al sinds 1998 met een enorme passie voor data en techniek en een echte
resultaatgerichte, no-nonsense mentaliteit. In een open, transparante werkomgeving geven wij onze
specialisten graag de ruimte om het beste uit zichzelf te halen. De liefde voor het vak, de vrijheid
en de synergie tussen onze young potentials en vakrotten resulteren in een hecht teamgevoel.

## Werken in een data gedreven organisatie?

Bij In Summa werken wij voor klanten in de [maakindustrie][26], [transportsector][27] en [zorg][28].
En als [Microsoft Solution partner][29] maken wij data toegankelijk en beschikbaar in praktische
business intelligence dashboards. Dit doen wij in een hecht team dat op elkaar bouwt. Elke dag weer
werken we aan de mooiste resultaten. Ben jij enthousiast geworden en wil je bij ons werken?
Solliciteer dan vandaag nog!

# Optimize the world using data

De snel veranderende wereld van vandaag stelt organisaties voortdurend voor nieuwe uitdagingen.
Energietransitie, stijgende grondstofprijzen en een tekort aan gekwalificeerde mensen dwingen je
steeds kritischer om te gaan met resources. Hier komt In Summa om de hoek kijken.

[ Vraag advies aan ][18]
[ Over in summa ][19]

[Computer-Aided Engineering][20]

[Data Solutions ][21]

[Over in Summa][22]

## Data toegankelijk in praktische business intelligence dashboards

Bij In Summa is juist dit wat wij zichtbaar willen maken voor onze klanten in de maakindustrie,
transportsector en zorg. Als Microsoft Solution partner maken wij data toegankelijk en beschikbaar
in praktische business intelligence dashboards. Dankzij onze intensieve kennis van de branches en de
processen kunnen onze data engineers bedrijfsprocessen effectief optimaliseren door databronnen slim
met software te verbinden.

[ Ontdek meer over Business Intelligence ][23]

## Realisatie door betrokken en gedreven engineers

Daarnaast is In Summa exclusieve business partner van Hexagon’s Computer-Aided Engineering platform
voor de Benelux regio. Met deze state-of-the-art simulatiesoftware kunnen engineers en researchers
uit verschillende industriële sectoren ontwerpen virtueel en proactief testen op veiligheid,
kosten en duurzaamheid. Zo optimaliseren we samen resources voor diverse industriële sectoren. 

Omdat onze toegewijde en gedreven engineers de [Hexagon][24] tools van binnen en van buiten kennen,
kunnen wij onze klanten bovendien optimaal ondersteunen met advies en training.

[ Ontdek meer over Simulatie Software ][25]

## En dat sinds 1998, met een enorme passie voor data en techniek

Dat doen wij al sinds 1998 met een enorme passie voor data en techniek en een echte
resultaatgerichte, no-nonsense mentaliteit. In een open, transparante werkomgeving geven wij onze
specialisten graag de ruimte om het beste uit zichzelf te halen. De liefde voor het vak, de vrijheid
en de synergie tussen onze young potentials en vakrotten resulteren in een hecht teamgevoel.

## Werken in een data gedreven organisatie?

Bij In Summa werken wij voor klanten in de [maakindustrie][26], [transportsector][27] en [zorg][28].
En als [Microsoft Solution partner][29] maken wij data toegankelijk en beschikbaar in praktische
business intelligence dashboards. Dit doen wij in een hecht team dat op elkaar bouwt. Elke dag weer
werken we aan de mooiste resultaten. Ben jij enthousiast geworden en wil je bij ons werken?
Solliciteer dan vandaag nog!

# Siemens acquires Altair

Altair has been acquired by Siemens, creating the world's most complete AI-powered portfolio of
industrial software for simulation, high-performance computing, data science and artificial
intelligence as part of the Siemens Xcelerator platform.

## Forward together with Siemens

[digital industries altair brandmark with a white background ]

For forty years, Altair has explored the science of possibility with our customers. We have made the
impossible, possible by leveraging the convergence of rocket science and data science, propelled by
high-performance computing.

As Altair technology joins Siemens, the world’s #1 industrial software company, we’re poised to help
you create faster, build smarter and scale beyond what we ever imagined, together.

## Helping you find your way

Transform and scale your processes with cutting edge solutions within the Siemens Xcelerator
portfolio. Altair software has been integrated throughout the Siemens software portfolio to continue
providing proven results for your toughest challenges.

[Two people are collaborating in an office, looking at a large screen displaying a 3D engineering
design of a complex part]

### Altair HyperWorks

The software within the Altair HyperWorks platform have been integrated into the Simcenter
simulation and test solution portfolio.

[Learn about Simcenter][7]
[altair-hpcworks-server-room]

### Altair HPCWorks

HPC and cloud products that were formerly within the Altair HPCWorks platform can now be found
within HPCWorks.

[Learn about HPCWorks][8]
[A person is seen from behind, working on a laptop displaying an "Auto AI" data science interface
with a decision tree diagram]

### Altair RapidMiner

Data analytics, AI, and machine learning solutions that were part of the Altair RapidMiner portfolio
are now part of Rapidminer.

[Learn about Rapidminer][9]

### Altair One

Access your tools, data, and computing resources while unleashing the power of AI with Altair One, a
revolutionary cloud gateway.

[More about Altair One][10]

### Altair Units

Get full access to our suite of software tools whenever you need them with Altair Units. Learn more
about our all-in and always-on licensing system.

[More about Altair Units][11]

### Altair Partner Alliance

The Altair Partner Alliance is now referred to as the Advanced Partner Alliance. Learn how to become
a partner and how you can benefit as a customer.

[More about APA][12]

## Customer support

****

### Visit the Siemens Customer Center

Altair's support services have transitioned to the Siemens Support Center. For up-to-date
information on the migration and for getting started how-to’s on the Siemens Support Center please
visit the following pages:
* [Support migration updates][13]
* [Siemens Digital Industries Software - Getting started][14]
* [Four steps to: Register for Support Center][15]
* [Starting your Support Center Journey][16]

[Visit Customer Center][17]
[A young woman wearing a striped shirt and a lavender top, is focused on a computer monitor at her
desk, holding a pen]

## Additional resources

* [Contact us][18]
* [Learning and training ][19]
* [Free trials ][20]

## Why **Aberdeen** Research?

Aberdeen Strategy & Research, a division of SWZD, has over three decades of extensive experience in
independent and credible market research that helps **illuminate** market realities and inform
business strategies. Our fact-based, unbiased, and outcome-centric research approach **inspires**
critical thinking and **ignites** data-driven business actions. Spanning an ever-growing base of
practice areas, our research explores today’s key markets and delves deep into the strategic aspects
of business, including: Technology, Customer Management, and Business Operations.

## What Sets **Aberdeen** Apart?

[Fact-based] **Fact-based:** Collecting data from thousands of business leaders across multiple job
roles and industries, Aberdeen’s survey-driven methodology ensures a foundation of research that is
based on fact rather than opinion.

[Fact-based] **Unbiased:** Our expert team of industry analysts and research professionals leverage
their knowledge from market experience and primary research data to generate powerful, unbiased
content that resonates with technology buyers and influencers.

[Outcome-centric] **Outcome-centric:** Aberdeen’s maturity class framework underpins the analysis of
how companies are performing against organizational goals, employee performance, and other metrics
to evaluate legacy and emerging technologies and their impact on business.

#### [**Chemical Surface Detector (CSD)**][117]

Access Engineering provided mechanical design and FEA analysis of CSD system that leverages UV Raman
spectroscopy to provide high-speed, on-the-move detection and identification of chemicals on
surfaces for the military.

[[High Energy Laser (HEL) Beam Director]][118]

#### [**High Energy Laser (HEL) Beam Director**][119]

Mechanical design and analysis of a gimbal which is a critical component used in directed energy
systems. Its provides precise aiming and stabilization of the energy beam to the target.

[[Joint Biological Standoff Detection System (JBSDS)]][120]

#### [**Joint Biological Standoff Detection System (JBSDS)**][121]

Mechanical Engineering support for a LIDAR system that enables standoff detection, discrimination,
and warning of Biological Warfare Agent (BWA) clouds.

[[Compact Thermal Management System]][122]

#### [**Compact Thermal Management System**][123]

Mechanical design and development of a passive heat pipe system to cool down a UV Raman laser
chamber. CAD and FEA tools are implemented iteratively to satisfy client’s MIL-STD-810G reliability
requirements.

[[Process Skid for a Concentrated Solar System]][124]

#### [**Process Skid for a Concentrated Solar System**][125]

Access Engineering designed and developed a compact heat exchanger pumping station unit to cool down
and extract the thermal energy from a utility-scale concentrated photovoltaic thermal (CPVT)
receiver.

[[Pulsed Power Marx System with Spiral Horns]][126]

#### [**Pulsed Power Marx System with Spiral Horns**][127]

Mechanical design of a Marx-type Electromagnetic Pulse (EMP) generator. It generates bursts of EM
energy that disrupts or destroys electronic systems in a targeted area without direct harm to people
or infrastructure.

The acquisition

## Acquired by ComplyAdvantage in 2024.

On 24 April 2024, ComplyAdvantage — the AI-driven financial crime intelligence firm protecting over
1,000 enterprises across 75 countries — acquired Golden.

01

### Into the ingestion layer

Golden's data extraction and entity-disambiguation methods now feed ComplyAdvantage's ingestion
pipeline, sharpening real-time risk insights for regulated institutions.

02

### Two teams, united

Golden's AI and large-language-model specialists joined ComplyAdvantage's data science team to build
on interconnected data at scale.

03

### Founder as advisor

Founder and CEO Jude Gomila joined ComplyAdvantage as a board observer and special advisor. a16z
became a top shareholder of the combined company.

"Financial crime insights built on *interconnected data* have been our north star."
[Visit ComplyAdvantage →][5]
The story

## A self-constructing knowledge base.

Golden set out to map human knowledge with machine intelligence — automating one of the world's
largest knowledge graphs from millions of disparate sources.

Founded · 2017 Golden

Jude Gomila starts Golden in San Francisco to combine artificial and human intelligence into one
continuously reconciled record.

Seed · 2019 $5M

a16z, Founders Fund, Gigafund and SV Angel back the first self-constructing knowledge database.

Series A · 2021 $14.5M

Led by a16z; Marc Andreessen joins the board. Golden closes a $1M US Air Force contract.

Series B · 2022 $40M

a16z leads again to scale the graph, bringing Golden's total funding to roughly $59.5M.

Acquired · 2024 ComplyAdvantage

Golden joins ComplyAdvantage to power AI-enriched financial crime intelligence worldwide.

The team

## Founder, engineers, and the investors behind them.

Golden was founded by Jude Gomila — a Cambridge engineer who previously co-founded the mobile
platform Heyzap (acquired 2016) — and built by a small team of AI, NLP and knowledge-graph
specialists.

Founder & CEO Jude Gomila

Set the mission of mapping the world's knowledge; now board observer and special advisor at
ComplyAdvantage.

Lead investor a16z

Andreessen Horowitz backed every round; Marc Andreessen served on Golden's board.

Backers Founders Fund

With Gigafund, SV Angel, DCVC and angels — roughly $59.5M raised across seed, Series A and Series B.

The team AI & NLP

Engineers specialising in data extraction, entity disambiguation and large language models — now
part of ComplyAdvantage's data science team.

[GOLDEN.com][6]

A self-constructing knowledge graph founded in San Francisco in 2017. Acquired by ComplyAdvantage in
2024.
